ensureLabels.zh:
请为当前仓库补全缺失的核心标签（共 10 个）：

必备标签：bug, needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wayfinder:grilling, wayfinder:map, wayfinder:prototype, wayfinder:research, wayfinder:task

步骤：
- [ ] 先看现在有哪些标签：调 deck_context 拿当前后端与仓库，票上带了哪些标签用 deck_issue_get 读
- [ ] 缺哪个补哪个：调 deck_issue_patch 并把缺的标签名放进 addLabels —— 它按当前后端自己的方式打标签，已经有的不会重复建，成没成逐条回报
- [ ] 补完再调一次 deck_context 核对标签已齐

色值/描述以 src/shared/labels.js 单源为准，仅校验名子集。

只读仓库补不上标签（建标签要 push，给票打标要 triage 及以上）：这时先 fork 到自己名下，再把工作区 origin 指向 fork；插件只认 origin，不代改配置。
ensureLabels.en:
Please complete the missing canonical labels (10 total):

Required labels: bug, needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, wayfinder:grilling, wayfinder:map, wayfinder:prototype, wayfinder:research, wayfinder:task

Steps:
- [ ] See what labels exist now: call deck_context for the current backend and repo; read which labels a ticket carries with deck_issue_get
- [ ] Add whatever is missing: call deck_issue_patch with the missing names in addLabels — it applies labels the way the current backend does, never creates duplicates, and reports each one
- [ ] Re-check with deck_context until the labels are complete

Colors/descriptions are single-sourced in src/shared/labels.js; verification is name-subset only.

A read-only repo cannot take labels (creating labels needs push, labeling tickets needs triage or higher): fork it to your own account first, then point the workspace origin at the fork. The plugin only reads origin and never rewrites your config.

repoAccessFix.zh:
当前仓库读不通（工具报「取不到这个仓库」）。顺序要求：若仓库尚未创建，先走「创建并发布」完成建仓推送，再重查；请按序排查：
1. 仓库存在性：这个目录还没有远端仓库时，先点「创建并发布」（面板上那个两步向导会把仓库建好并推上去）；
2. 登录与权限：看环境检查里「已登录 GitHub」那一行的状态；私有仓库需要当前登录的账号有权限（权限不足与「找不到」在服务端都可能是 404）；
3. 网络与代理：看环境检查里网络那一类结果，按它的提示处理。
排查修复后请用户点「重新检查」。

subIssue.zh: 建边用 deck_map_link：父子边传 parentKey（把这张子票挂到那张地图下），阻塞边传 blockedBy（数组里放阻塞它的那几张票号）；工具自己按本后端的方式落下去，并逐条回报这条边落在哪一列。建完用 deck_map_snapshot 读回地图，核对子票张数与预期一致（deck_map_link 的逐条明细里带着每一条边的读回落点与证据原话）。判「落上了」只看写后读回：读回里看不到这条边就不算落上；读不回来时如实说没确认，绝不报成已经挂上。
subIssue.en: Wire edges with deck_map_link: pass parentKey for the parent-child edge (attach this child under that map) and blockedBy for blocking edges (the numbers of the tickets blocking it); the tool lands each edge the way this backend does and reports, per edge, which column it landed in. Then read the map back with deck_map_snapshot and confirm the child count matches the plan (deck_map_link returns, per edge, the read-back landing and its evidence). Landing is only claimed when the read-back taken after the write shows the edge; when that read-back cannot be taken the tool says plainly that the edge is unconfirmed, never that it landed.

healthCheck.zh:
**这条后端查数与动手都走工具**（总纲里的三条口径在这里不变）。

查数：用 deck_context 拿当前后端与仓库；用 deck_map_snapshot 逐张读地图的子票清单（出现在任何一张清单里的都不算游离）。

建边：用 deck_map_link 的 parentKey 把票挂到选中的地图下（原生子议题边与它的读回校验都由工具负责）。{subIssue}

阻塞关系：用 deck_map_link 的 blockedBy 传阻塞它的那张票的票号；工具按本后端的方式落下去，并在返回值里说清落在哪一列（判落上只看写后读回，读不回来就说没确认，不报成已挂上）。

报告按标签与建议类型分区，但体检的范围是全部开放票、不跟随面板当前的筛选。
healthCheck.en:
**On this backend, counting and acting both go through the tools** (the three rules from the general section stay as they are).

Counting: use deck_context for the current backend and repo; read each map's child list with deck_map_snapshot (anything appearing in any list is not orphaned).

Attaching: use deck_map_link with parentKey to attach a ticket under the chosen map (the tool owns the native sub-ticket edge and its read-back check). {subIssue}

Blocking: use deck_map_link with blockedBy, passing the numbers of the tickets that block it; the tool lands the edge the way this backend does and says which column it used (landing is only claimed when the read-back after the write shows the edge; when it cannot be read back the tool says it is unconfirmed rather than claiming it landed).

Group the report by label and suggestion type, but the health check always covers every open ticket and does not follow the current panel filters.

subIssue.zh: 在本仓库的 map 文件里，按已有写法在任务清单逐条引用这些子票，并把清单条目数与 map 的子票数对齐一致

healthCheck.zh:
**本后端的票就是工作区里的文件**（每个工作单元一个目录，地图写在 map.md 里、每张票写成一个文件），所以「游离」必须落到文件上。**查两条文件级判据**：
1. 票文件存在，却没有被任何 map.md 的清单引用 —— 游离在外；
2. map.md 的清单里列了某张票，但对应的文件不存在 —— 断链。

**一条 AI 判断照同一套口径一起带上**：对每一张判一句「这张是不是明确可以单张票处理掉的」；是的话也可以不管，只登记一行。

**三种结论**（挂在某张地图下 / 建议自立成一张新地图 / 建议留在原地 + 一句话理由）都只进建议清单，等人点头才动手。

**不碰**：已关闭的票、任何票的标题与正文、标签与认领状态、别的仓库；不关票、不改源码、不提交。

体检的范围是这个工作区里的全部票文件，不跟随面板当前的筛选。
healthCheck.en:
**On this backend a ticket is a file in this workspace** (one directory per work unit, the map written as map.md and each ticket as a file), so "orphaned" has to land on files. **Check two file-level criteria**:
1. a ticket file exists but no map.md list references it — it is floating outside;
2. a map.md list references a ticket whose file does not exist — a broken link.

**One AI judgement on the same rules**: for each ticket, judge with one sentence — "is this clearly something a single ticket can finish?" If yes, you may also leave it alone and just log one line.

**All three conclusions** (attach under a map / suggest a new map of its own / suggest leaving it where it is + a one-sentence reason) only go into the suggestion list — act only after the human nods.

**Never touch**: closed tickets, any ticket title or body, labels and claim state, other repositories; do not close tickets, change source code, or commit.

The health check covers every ticket file in this workspace and does not follow the current panel filters.

glabInstallFix.zh:
请为 DSH 安装 GitLab CLI（glab）：
1. 先检查：终端执行 glab --version；
2. 无 glab 则按 OS 安装：Windows → winget install --id GitLab.gitlab-cli（或 scoop install glab）；macOS → brew install glab；Linux → 按 gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli 官方方式安装；
3. 安装完成后请用户点「重查」。

glabLoginFix.zh: 请完成 glab 登录（glab auth login）：按向导选择 GitLab.com → HTTPS → 浏览器授权（OAuth）；完成后 glab auth status 验证；然后请用户点「重查」。
glabLoginFix.en: Complete glab login: glab auth login → GitLab.com → HTTPS → browser OAuth; verify with glab auth status; then ask the user to re-check.

glabRepoFix.zh:
当前工作区未解析出 GitLab 仓库（glab 无法定位 owner/project）。请先向用户确认意图：
A. 本地项目（不需要 GitLab）→ 切换到「本地 Markdown」后端；
B. 确实要用 GitLab → 核对 remote 指向（git remote get-url origin / glab config），或 glab repo create 创建并关联；
完成后请用户点「重查」。
glabRepoFix.en: No GitLab repository resolved for the current workspace. Confirm intent: A. local project → switch to "Local Markdown"; B. GitLab really wanted → verify the remote (git remote get-url origin / glab config), or create/associate via glab repo create; then ask the user to re-check.

subIssue.zh: 建边用 deck_map_link：父子边传 parentKey、阻塞边传 blockedBy。要注意本后端的能力边界 —— 父子边不走接口，落在票正文顶部的 Part of #<地图> 声明行（读回走契约的父子列）。GitLab 平台本身有原生父子层级，但它在 work items 那条路上（入口是界面与 GraphQL），本房不走那条；要远端认的层级得另开一票换成 GraphQL。阻塞边走原生 is_blocked_by：有能力就真写、写后读回核对；免费档拿不到原生能力时，工具回落到正文首行的那行降级写法。建完用 deck_map_snapshot 读回地图，核对子票张数与预期一致。
subIssue.en: Wire edges with deck_map_link: parentKey for the parent-child edge, blockedBy for blocking edges. Mind this backend's limit — the parent-child edge does not go through the API; it lands as a Part of #<map> declaration line at the top of the ticket body (read back through the contract parent column). GitLab itself does have a native parent-child hierarchy, but it lives on the work-items path (reached through the UI and GraphQL), which this backend does not use; a remotely-recognised hierarchy would be a new capability on GraphQL. Blocking edges use native is_blocked_by: written for real with read-back verification when capable; on the free tier without native capability the tool falls back to the first line of the body. Then read the map back with deck_map_snapshot and confirm the child count matches the plan.

healthCheck.zh:
**游离的开放票**在这条后端上的落地口径：这张票**没有关闭**、**自己不是地图**、**不在任何地图的子票里** —— 与另一条远端后端同一套（两个后端的票仓结构本来就是同一套：地图 + 子议题 + 阻塞边）。

**动手时只做两件结构动作**，都走工具：
1. 建边，把票挂到合适的地图下：deck_map_link 的 parentKey；
2. 为人点过头的票开一张新地图：deck_map_plan_create 先写最小的 Destination 草稿。

**本后端做不到的地方，如实写出来**：父子边落在票正文顶部的 Part of #<地图> 声明行（原生层级在 work items 那条路上，本房不走），解析率也还没用真仓库量过 —— 动手之前先量一次，量与不出来的原因都写进报告，**不要硬来**。

**不碰**：已关闭的票、任何票的标题与正文、标签与认领状态、别的仓库；不关票、不删评论、不改源码、不发版、不提交。

报告按标签与建议类型分区，但体检的范围是全部开放票、不跟随面板当前的筛选。
healthCheck.en:
**How "orphaned open ticket" lands on this backend**: the ticket is **not closed**, it is **not itself a map**, and it is **not inside any map as a sub-ticket** — the same rules as the other remote backend (both backends share one ticket-store shape: maps + sub-tickets + blocking edges).

**When acting, only two structural actions**, both through the tools:
1. Wire the edge that attaches the ticket under a suitable map: deck_map_link with parentKey;
2. Open a new map for a ticket the human has nodded on: deck_map_plan_create, writing only the minimal Destination draft.

**State plainly what this backend cannot do**: the parent-child edge lands as a Part of #<map> declaration line at the top of the ticket body (the native hierarchy lives on the work-items path, which this backend does not use); its resolution rate has not been measured against a real repository yet — measure once before acting, write both the measurement and any reason it fails into the report, and **do not force it**.

**Never touch**: closed tickets, any ticket title or body, labels and claim state, other repositories; do not close tickets, delete comments, change source code, publish a release, or commit.
